info.description: OpenAPI description of the documented DataFast REST API v1. Website endpoints use the /api/v1 base path; account administration endpoints are under /api/v1/admin. All requests use a Bearer token: df_ website API keys are scoped to one website, while dft_ account tokens require the relevant permission and websiteId on website-scoped routes. Keep tokens secret.
